## Cadwell Clinical Solutions

We value customer input, innovation, product quality, intuitive usability, and outstanding user
support to set new standards with our neurology solutions for EEG brain monitoring; EMG, EP, NCS and
Ultrasound; IONM surgical monitoring; PSG and HSAT sleep diagnostics; data management; and neuro
consumables.
[Clinical Solutions][109]

Visit the Support site to **register for free online support** (United States, Caribbean and U.S.
Territory customers only). Discover training videos that cover everything from licensing the
software through setup and configuration, as well as helpful downloads and software updates!

[Sign Up Today!][110]

## Cadwell's next generation of leadership

CEO Patrick Jensen and SVP/VP of R&D John Cadwell, Jr., continue to serve our neurology customers
and their patients. Cadwell is committed to combining customer insight and decades of employee
expertise to create cutting-edge technology and provide market-leading customer support.

## Cadwell Education hosts live neurology workshops and in-booth demonstrations at conventions

 

### What are you interested in?

[Cadwell Workshops][111]
[Conventions][112]


## Cadwell electrodes, consumables, supplies, and accessories for neurology

Cadwell offers a full suite of electrodiagnostic supplies for electroencephalography,
electromyography, nerve conduction studies, evoked potential, neuromuscular ultrasound,
intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring and sleep diagnostics.

[Shop at Cadwell's Estore][113]

## Cadwell is honored to give back to medical and community missions around the world

 

*“Thank you so much for your generous donation to Children’s Hope in Jacmel, Haiti… With the Cadwell
donation, I was able to use battery power in a mountain environment with no electricity.”*

# Steadfast Neuromonitoring Care, Practiced Without Compromise

The Gold Standard in Neuroscience Services^{TM}
[The Joint Commission Logo]
Accredited with The Joint Commission since 2010

IntraNerve Neuroscience partners with hospitals and physicians to provide intraoperative
neuromonitoring, EEG, and remote professional interpretation grounded in integrity, transparency,
and accountable clinical judgment.

We are one of the few neuroscience service providers offering both IONM and EEG under one unified
model allowing care teams to work with a single, trusted partner across complex neurological needs.
When decisions carry weight and time is limited, we provide clear insight, steady communication, and
dependable support so care teams can act with confidence, even under pressure.

[ Request a Conversation ][12]
our services

## How We Support Care Teams

Effective neuromonitoring depends on more than technology. It’s a responsibility that requires sound
judgment, clear communication, and a deep respect for the clinical environment in which decisions
are made. Our services are designed to reduce uncertainty, support neurological outcomes, and
integrate seamlessly into care teams when collaborate matters most.

### Intraoperative Monitoring (IONM)

Our intraoperative neuromonitoring services support surgeons during procedures where neurological
structures are most vulnerable. We provide vigilant, real-time oversight and immediate
communication, approaching each case with precision, consistency, and respect for the gravity of the
operating room.

The goal is simple: early awareness, clear interpretation, and support you can rely on when every
moment counts.
[ Learn More ][13]

### Neurotelemetry / cEEG

We provide high-quality EEG and continuous EEG services with steady, 24/7 monitoring and reliable
clinical interpretation. Our model prioritizes continuity and responsiveness, enabling neurological
monitoring without gaps, guesswork, or unnecessary escalation.

We maintain a strict 4:1 patient-to-physician ratio for continuous EEG interpretation—a
non-negotiable standard that ensures focused review, timely responses, and clinical insight that is
never diluted by volume. And remote access delivers this expertise wherever patients are, upholding
the same rigorous standards of quality and accountability.
[ Learn More ][14]

### Remote Professional Interpretation

Our board-certified neurologists, epileptologists, and neurophysiologists provide direct,
accountable interpretation for EEG and IONM cases nationwide. Our remote interpretation model is
designed to introduce human connection where it often goes overlooked; through our secure portal,
technologists can see exactly which physician they are working with on each case, fostering
familiarity, trust, and genuine communication collaboration.

There are no layers of handoff and no ambiguity—just experienced physicians offering responsible
clinical insight, available 24/7, through secure and reliable systems designed for high-stakes car
[ Learn More ][15]
[ Request a conversation ][16]

## How We Support Care Teams

Effective neuromonitoring depends on more than technology. It’s a responsibility that requires sound
judgment, clear communication, and a deep respect for the clinical environment in which decisions
are made. Our services are designed to reduce uncertainty, support neurological outcomes, and
integrate seamlessly into care teams when collaborate matters most.

### Intraoperative Monitoring (IONM)

Our intraoperative neuromonitoring services support surgeons during procedures where neurological
structures are most vulnerable. We provide vigilant, real-time oversight and immediate
communication, approaching each case with precision, consistency, and respect for the gravity of the
operating room.

The goal is simple: early awareness, clear interpretation, and support you can rely on when every
moment counts.
[ Learn More ][13]

### Neurotelemetry / cEEG

We provide high-quality EEG and continuous EEG services with steady, 24/7 monitoring and reliable
clinical interpretation. Our model prioritizes continuity and responsiveness, enabling neurological
monitoring without gaps, guesswork, or unnecessary escalation.

We maintain a strict 4:1 patient-to-physician ratio for continuous EEG interpretation—a
non-negotiable standard that ensures focused review, timely responses, and clinical insight that is
never diluted by volume. And remote access delivers this expertise wherever patients are, upholding
the same rigorous standards of quality and accountability.
[ Learn More ][14]

Our board-certified neurologists, epileptologists, and neurophysiologists provide direct,
accountable interpretation for EEG and IONM cases nationwide. Our remote interpretation model is
designed to introduce human connection where it often goes overlooked; through our secure portal,
technologists can see exactly which physician they are working with on each case, fostering
familiarity, trust, and genuine communication collaboration.

clinical insight, available 24/7, through secure and reliable systems designed for high-stakes car

### people first,

## Kind Words From the Teams We Serve

Explore real reviews from partners that trust us. Their satisfaction drives us to keep finding
better ways to meet your needs.
“ IntraNerve's staff is exceptional and provides the highest level of care to our patients. Their
management team is responsive when we need support and their contracting prices/fees are reasonable
when benchmarked against other providers. We have been beyond pleased and satisfied with their
service. ”
Surgery Buyer/Sourcing Contract Analyst
"INN has been instrumental in our ability to have an Epilepsy Monitoring Unit at our facility. Their
entire team is professional, courteous and respond quickly to our ever-changing needs. Everyone I
have worked with have been fantastic and I could not recommend their services enough. If you have a
gap in your service line or are looking to grow, you couldn't pick a better company to partner
with."
Hospital Administrator/Management Staff
"We have some experience with a different reading group and are so thankful that we have IntraNerve
at our hospital! We review every EEG read and are happy with the quality and accuracy. The staff is
wonderful and very responsive, we would highly recommend IntraNerve."

"Communication is key to success. As long as everyone's on the same page, we can work through

Administrative Coordinator
"IntraNerve has been with us since we began building our program, and they have been instrumental in

We’re inspired by positive patient outcomes. Over more than 80 years we’ve delivered
industry-leading technology, expert service, and specialized education to make a world of difference
in the lives of care providers and their patients.

[Neuro Solutions][103]

We put clinicians first in the consideration and development of each solution we provide. We deliver
innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

We are committed to helping healthcare providers worldwide feel confident they can achieve the best
possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

[ Our Story ][39]

[ Our Vision ][41]

## Pioneering the **future**

Blackrock Neurotech is a team of the world’s **leading engineers, neuroscientists, and
visionaries**. Together, we’ve developed the most powerful neurotechnology platform that **improves
patients’ lives today.**
[ Our Vision ][42]

19 +

years of human studies

30K +

days of implant research

1k +

research institutions

2k +

published studies

### Engineering possibilities

Our **breakthrough technologies provide new hope** for people with paralysis & other neurological
disorders.

Using our brain tech, BCI Pioneers have been able to **eat, drink, send emails, and operate robotic
arms **just by thinking.

Our technology has enabled patients to type at up to **90 characters per minute** and decode up to
** 62 words per minute** from thought.

Some Pioneers use their BCI to **play video games, use Photoshop, **and even **paint **using
brain-controlled robotic arms.

##### Used by the world’s leading institutions

We’ve equipped more than **1000 labs** from **world-renowned institutions** with industry-leading
neurotechnology devices.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## Registration Now Open!

Registration is now open for the AAO-HNSF 2026 Annual Meeting & OTO EXPO, held Saturday, October 17
– Tuesday, October 20, in Los Angeles, California.

[Learn More][188] [Register Now][189]

## 2026-2027 FLEX Registration Now Open!

FLEX provides the knowledge, education, clinical tools, and professional support to help you meet
the challenges of your otolaryngology practice and build mastery throughout your career.

[Learn More][190]

## Business of Medicine

The Academy advocates for otolaryngology—head and neck surgeons related to providing services to
both Medicare and private payer patients.

[Learn More][191]

][193]

## Featured News

#### 2026 Election Results

Thank you for sharing your voice and helping to decide the future of your specialty. The 2026
election results are now in! Find out which leaders were selected to serve your Academy.

[Learn More][194]

#### 2026 Annual Meeting Travel Grants Now Open

Travel grants for the AAO-HNSF 2026 Annual Meeting & OTO EXPO are now open. Eligible groups include
medical student members, current resident members, active U.S. military residents, residents of
African descent from the U.S., Caribbean, or Canada, and members within their first 1–5 years of
practice. Apply by Wednesday, July 29.

[Learn More][195]

#### Register Today for the 2026 AAO-HNS Career Fair

Join us for the 2026 AAO-HNS Career Fair, taking place Sunday, October 18 at the JW Marriott in Los
Angeles, California. Specially curated for early career physicians, residents, fellows, and seasoned
professionals seeking new horizons in the U.S., this event connects you directly with organizations
hiring in otolaryngology. Meet recruiters face-to-face, explore new practice opportunities, and take
the next step in your career journey. Best of all, registration is free.

[Learn More][196]

# Top Follow APK — Grow Your Instagram for Free

Earn real followers, likes and views without paying a cent.

Top Follow is a community-powered Android app that turns small in-app actions into a steady stream
of genuine Instagram engagement. No password, no bots, no monthly fee — just creators helping
creators grow.

[ Download APK][5]
[Top Follow app dashboard] [Top Follow earn coins screen] [Top Follow follower order screen]

## A simpler way to gain Instagram followers

Standing out on Instagram is harder every year. Hashtag reach is shrinking, organic posts get fewer
impressions, and paid ads quickly burn through small budgets. Top Follow offers a different path: a
fair exchange where every Instagram user supports another. You earn coins by liking and following,
then redeem them for followers on your own page — all from a clean Android app.

## Why creators choose Top Follow

Real Instagram users

Daily coin bonuses

Instant delivery

Malware-free APK

Lightweight build

## Built for first-time users

The interface is minimal on purpose. Coins, orders and rewards each live behind a single tap, so you
can move from install to first follower order in under a minute. Nothing to read, nothing to
configure.

## Followers from active accounts

Because every coin costs a real action from another user, the followers you receive belong to people
who actually open Instagram daily. Your engagement rate stays healthy and your reach keeps
compounding instead of dropping.

## A growth loop that pays you back

The longer you use the app, the more coins you accumulate — and the more coins you accumulate, the
larger the follower batches you can order. New tasks refresh throughout the day, so consistent users
always have a way to climb.

## Frequently asked questions

1 What is Top Follow APK?

Top Follow is a free Android app that connects Instagram users in a coin-based community. You earn
coins by interacting with other accounts and spend them to receive followers, likes, or views on
your own profile.

2 Is Top Follow safe to use?

The APK is checked for malware before each release and never asks for your main Instagram password.
To stay on the safe side, sign in with a secondary Instagram account inside the app.

3 Are the followers I receive real people?

Yes. Each follower comes from another active user who chose to follow you in exchange for coins, so
your audience is made of real Instagram accounts rather than bots or empty profiles.

4 How quickly will I see new followers?

Most users notice their first batch of followers within minutes of placing an order. Spending a few
minutes on the app every day can produce hundreds of new followers per week.

5 Does Top Follow work on iPhone or PC?

The app is built for Android, but Windows and macOS users can run it through emulators such as
BlueStacks. iOS users can install it through third-party tools like AltStore.

## How Top Follow works in practice

Five steps to take your Instagram from forgotten to followed.

### 1. Install the APK on Android

Download the latest version directly from this site and tap the file in your Downloads folder. If
your device blocks the install, enable "Install unknown apps" for your browser and try again. The
whole process takes less than a minute.

### 2. Create a separate Instagram login

Top Follow only ever needs a secondary Instagram account. Keeping your main profile out of the app
is the single most important habit for long-term safety, and it lets you experiment with rewards
without any pressure.

### 3. Earn coins with quick tasks

The earnings tab shows a constantly refreshing list of profiles to follow and posts to like. Each
completed action adds coins to your balance — most users build enough for their first order within
ten minutes of casual scrolling.

### 4. Redeem coins for followers

Open the followers panel, type the username of your main Instagram account, and choose how many
followers you want delivered. Confirm the order and the queue starts processing right away.

THE POWER

THE POWER

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

enabling technologies to accommodate various techniques.

#### Our Mission

peripheral and central nervous system in the oeprating room.  We aim to provide surgeons & patients

## Pioneering Excellence in Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilization


At Hedone USA, we specialize in the design, production, and distribution of performance validated
Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilizers, Acidic Scrubbers, HVAC and Air Purifier Devices. These systems are
renowned for their efficacy in ensuring the sterility of medical devices, thereby safeguarding
health and enhancing the overall quality of care. Our ETO Sterilizers and Air Handling Units are
engineered to meet the stringent demands of the medical industry, delivering unparalleled
reliability and performance.

[Learn More][19]

## Surgical Suture and Critical Environment Solutions

[ [Our Mission] [Our Mission] ][20]
[

##### Our Mission

][21]

HEDONE USA is committed to advancing healthcare by providing innovative ethylene oxide sterilization
systems, critical environmental control solutions, and precision machinery for surgical suture
production, ensuring safety, reliability, and efficiency for medical facilities worldwide.

[Learn More][22]
[ [Why Choose Us] [Why Choose Us] ][23]
[

##### Why Choose Us

][24]

Choose HEDONE USA for cutting-edge healthcare solutions, tailored support, and global expertise in
ethylene oxide sterilization, advanced HVAC systems, and precision suture production machinery,
ensuring safety, quality, and innovation for your facility.

[Learn More][25]

## Everything You Need for Healthcare

[
[Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilizer ]
Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilizer
Compliance with relevant standards and regulations, such as ISO 11135, EN 1422, ATEX 2014/34/UE,
ANSI/AAMI/ISO 13485, CFR 21 PART 11, EN 550, ISO 10993-7, ISO 14937, ANSI/AAMI ST41, 21 CFR Part 820
][26]
[
[Acidic Scrubber]
Acidic Scrubber
Acidic scrubber effectively neutralizes ethylene oxide gas using sulfuric acid, ensuring safe
sterilization with 0 PPM waste in medical facilities.
][27]
[
[Surgical Suture Production Machinery ]
Surgical Suture Production Machinery
We offer comprehensive services in the design and development of suture manufacturing facilities. We
specialize in providing all the necessary devices for producing high-quality surgical sutures,
including Clean Room, Suture Winding Machines, Needle Attaching Units, Braiding Machines, Glove
Boxes, Dry Cabinets and Packaging Equipment.
][28]
[
[HVAC and Air Purifiers ]
HVAC and Air Purifiers
We manufacture advanced HVAC central units and air purifiers equipped with HEPA filters, UVC light
technology, and negative ion generation, designed to enhance indoor air quality and safety in
medical and public environments.
][29]
[
[Steam Sterilizer - OEM ]
Steam Sterilizer - OEM
HEDONE USA LLC offers comprehensive OEM manufacturing solutions for high-performance Steam
Sterilizers tailored to meet the needs of hospitals, laboratories, dental clinics, and
pharmaceutical production facilities. Backed by extensive experience in medical device
manufacturing, we provide robust, compliant, and scalable solutions for companies seeking to
introduce reliable sterilization products under their own brand.
][30]

## Pioneering Excellence in Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilization


At Hedone USA, we specialize in the design, production, and distribution of performance validated
Ethylene Oxide Gas Sterilizers, Acidic Scrubbers, HVAC and Air Purifier Devices. These systems are
renowned for their efficacy in ensuring the sterility of medical devices, thereby safeguarding
health and enhancing the overall quality of care. Our ETO Sterilizers and Air Handling Units are
engineered to meet the stringent demands of the medical industry, delivering unparalleled
reliability and performance.

[Learn More][19]

## Surgical Suture and Critical Environment Solutions

[ [Our Mission] [Our Mission] ][20]
[

##### Our Mission

][21]

HEDONE USA is committed to advancing healthcare by providing innovative ethylene oxide sterilization
systems, critical environmental control solutions, and precision machinery for surgical suture
production, ensuring safety, reliability, and efficiency for medical facilities worldwide.

[Learn More][22]
[ [Why Choose Us] [Why Choose Us] ][23]
[

##### Why Choose Us

][24]

Choose HEDONE USA for cutting-edge healthcare solutions, tailored support, and global expertise in
ethylene oxide sterilization, advanced HVAC systems, and precision suture production machinery,
ensuring safety, quality, and innovation for your facility.

[Learn More][25]

## Everything You Need for Healthcare

[

ANSI/AAMI/ISO 13485, CFR 21 PART 11, EN 550, ISO 10993-7, ISO 14937, ANSI/AAMI ST41, 21 CFR Part 820
][26]
[
[Acidic Scrubber]
Acidic Scrubber
Acidic scrubber effectively neutralizes ethylene oxide gas using sulfuric acid, ensuring safe
sterilization with 0 PPM waste in medical facilities.
][27]
[
[Surgical Suture Production Machinery ]
Surgical Suture Production Machinery
We offer comprehensive services in the design and development of suture manufacturing facilities. We
specialize in providing all the necessary devices for producing high-quality surgical sutures,
including Clean Room, Suture Winding Machines, Needle Attaching Units, Braiding Machines, Glove
Boxes, Dry Cabinets and Packaging Equipment.
][28]
[
[HVAC and Air Purifiers ]
HVAC and Air Purifiers
We manufacture advanced HVAC central units and air purifiers equipped with HEPA filters, UVC light
technology, and negative ion generation, designed to enhance indoor air quality and safety in
medical and public environments.
][29]
[
[Steam Sterilizer - OEM ]
Steam Sterilizer - OEM
HEDONE USA LLC offers comprehensive OEM manufacturing solutions for high-performance Steam
Sterilizers tailored to meet the needs of hospitals, laboratories, dental clinics, and
pharmaceutical production facilities. Backed by extensive experience in medical device
manufacturing, we provide robust, compliant, and scalable solutions for companies seeking to
introduce reliable sterilization products under their own brand.
][30]

# Helping Neurotech Make NYC

As the global leader in finance, policy, art, research, and medicine, the region is well-positioned
to lead neurotech and ensure our communities fully realize the profound, life-changing benefits it

01 **Community Orchestration**
Catalyze the local neurotech industry by bridging the gaps between companies, clinics, labs, and
investors to identify unmet needs, drive collaboration, connect resources, and scale impactful
innovations.
02 **Regional Advocacy**
Amplify awareness for neurotech in the greater NY region and elevate the industry's profile among
key influencers: policymakers, media, investors, and advocates.
03 **Ethical Stewardship**

guide progress towards improving the region's health, happiness, creativity, productivity, and

# Improving Lives

**Focusing on the development and commercialisation of NTI164 for multiple paediatric neurological
disorders**

[Learn More][26]

### ASX:NTI

Exclusive worldwide licence

Extensive preclinical studies completed

Potent anti-neuroinflammatory effects with NTI164

Paediatric Focus

NTI164 to be regulated as prescription-only drug

Patents Pending

Neurotech International Limited (ASX:NTI) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical development company
focused predominately on paediatric neurological disorders with a broad-spectrum oral cannabinoid
drug therapy called NTI164. Neurotech has completed a Phase II/III randomised, double-blind,
placebo-controlled clinical trial in Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) with clinically meaningful and
statistically significant benefits reported across a number of clinically-validated measures and
excellent safety.

In addition, Neurotech has completed and reported statistically significant and clinically
meaningful Phase I/II trials in ASD and Paediatric Autoimmune Neuropsychiatric Disorders Associated
with Streptococcal Infections (PANDAS) and Paediatric Acute-Onset Neuropsychiatric Syndrome (PANS),
collectively PANDAS/PANS along with Rett Syndrome. Neurotech has received human ethics committee
clearance for a Phase I/II clinical trial in spastic cerebral palsy.

[Learn More][27]

FACING
PROSTATE CANCER?

 

## SEXUAL DYSFUNCTION
## URINARY INCONTINENCE

*Real Risks* from Prostate Surgery

If Prostate Surgery is in your future, take steps to *minimize* these side effects
[KNOW BEFORE YOU GO][16]
[Para el español][17]

## KNOW YOUR OPTIONS

If your urologist is not recommending the use of this technology for your procedure, you may not be
receiving the best care available.
[Learn more][18]

## ASK YOUR DOCTOR

If your doctor will not use the Nerve Monitoring System, we will help find one that does.
[Find a Surgeon][19]

## ASSISTING SURGEONS. PROTECTING PATIENTS.

The ProPep^{®} Nerve Monitoring System is the first FDA-cleared real-time nerve monitoring system
for laparoscopic and robotic prostatectomy surgery. This system helps surgeons identify critical
non-visible somatic nerves at risk during surgery, thereby allowing the surgeon to make
more-informed decisions on how to spare these nerves, potentially minimizing nerve damage.

As a patient you should know that this type of nerve identification technology is standard of care
for thyroid and parotid surgery, both cancerous glands that need to be removed with vital nerves at
risk in doing so.


##### A PATIENT'S PERSPECTIVE

Hear Tim talk about his experience - from diagnosis to decision-making.

If your doctor will not use the Nerve Monitoring System, we will help find one that does.
[Find a Surgeon][19]

## ASSISTING SURGEONS. PROTECTING PATIENTS.

The ProPep^{®} Nerve Monitoring System is the first FDA-cleared real-time nerve monitoring system
for laparoscopic and robotic prostatectomy surgery. This system helps surgeons identify critical
non-visible somatic nerves at risk during surgery, thereby allowing the surgeon to make
more-informed decisions on how to spare these nerves, potentially minimizing nerve damage.

As a patient you should know that this type of nerve identification technology is standard of care
for thyroid and parotid surgery, both cancerous glands that need to be removed with vital nerves at
risk in doing so.

Hear Tim talk about his experience - from diagnosis to decision-making.
